info.description: The List Rideshare Drivers API enables users to retrieve comprehensive information about rideshare drivers within a specified context. This endpoint allows transportation network companies, fleet managers, and app developers to access key data regarding active drivers, their statuses, and associated rides. Use this API to enhance backend operations, improve customer experiences, or integrate with existing platforms. It serves as a crucial resource for optimizing rideshare service management and operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all ride details associated with a specific driver. Use this to get insights into ride history, statuses, and other related information for better management of driver activities.
